fields.subject: CMI Digest: Content Strategy Trends for Q2
fields.body_plain: Pillar-page strategy drives 3x organic traffic versus standalone blog posts.

fields.subject: March marketing budget approved
fields.body_plain: March budget has been approved: $185k total ($95k paid, $45k content, $25k events, $20k tools).

fields.subject: Weekly social performance summary
fields.body_plain: This week: 45 posts scheduled, 38 published, 7 in queue. Top post: 1.2k impressions on LinkedIn.

fields.subject: Creative assets for March campaign ready
fields.body_plain: Hi, the display ad creatives for the March awareness campaign are ready for review. 5 variants attached.

fields.subject: Invoice #MC-20260301 — $890.00
fields.body_plain: Invoice for Mailchimp Pro subscription — March 2026. Amount: $890.00. Due date: March 15.

fields.subject: Social Media Today: Instagram Algorithm Changes
fields.body_plain: Reels now prioritized 2x in feed ranking; carousel engagement up 22% in B2B verticals.

fields.subject: Q1 Marketing Review — Key Takeaways
fields.body_plain: Team, great quarter. Highlights: MQL target exceeded by 18%, CPL down 12%. See attached slides.

fields.subject: Zoom: Q1 Campaign Retrospective
fields.body_plain: You have been invited to Q1 Campaign Retrospective on March 7 at 10:00 AM.

fields.subject: MarketingConf 2026: Speaker applications open
fields.body_plain: Submit your talk proposal for MarketingConf 2026 in Chicago, May 14-16. Deadline: March 31.

fields.subject: Social media takeover — confirmed
fields.body_plain: Confirmed for the Instagram takeover on March 12. I'll send a content brief by Friday.

fields.subject: Campaign sent: March Newsletter
fields.body_plain: Your campaign 'March Newsletter' was sent to 4,230 subscribers. Open rate so far: 24.8%.

fields.subject: Link exchange proposal
fields.body_plain: We noticed your blog on SaaS marketing. Would you be open to a reciprocal backlink placement?

fields.subject: Keyword tracking report ready
fields.body_plain: Your weekly keyword tracking report is ready. 14 keywords improved position, 3 dropped.

fields.subject: New Event: Content Calendar Review
fields.body_plain: Team scheduled a 45-minute Content Calendar Review on March 6 at 3:00 PM.

fields.subject: Your team's Canva designs this week
fields.body_plain: Your team created 12 designs this week. Top performer: Social Media Templates folder.
